[image: Cathi was proud to join hundreds of her neighbors in support of Black lives. This rally, along York Road, was organized by a Rodgers Forge 7th-grader.]

[image: Cathi’s bill to close loopholes in the state’s Save4College program has helped low- and middle-income families, while saving taxpayers some $3 million a year.]
[image: For more than 10 years, Cathi has led the fight to rebuild the aging and overcrowded Towson High School. Today, construction is underway. This WYPR report tells the story.]
[image: This Sun article talks about food insecurity during the pandemic, and how Cathi rallied her district to do something about it.]

[image: Towson University’s College of Health Professions has never been more important to our state. Cathi was happy to greet them on a visit to Annapolis, and recently secured funding for a new, state-of-the-art building on campus.]
[image: When COVID-19 hit, Cathi responded. She organized the community and led a weekly food distribution that has served thousands of families in need. ]
